## Freed v26.10.200-dev

Jev spending controls and local GLiClass previews arrive with more reliable social capture and cheaper settled ranking refreshes.

### Features

- Try Jev with a personal key and conservative USD1 daily and USD10 calendar-month spending limits.
- Run GLiClass Base locally with verified official model downloads and no hosted fallback.

### Fixes

- Retain richer Facebook captures for existing post links.
- Reject contradictory social admission and recognize exact Instagram Sponsored headers in feeds and Stories.
- Scope Instagram recommendation labels to feed headers, preserving ordinary captions.
- Keep title, image and replies tied to the selected post.
- Stop FPS diagnostics sampling hidden windows and counting hidden time as dropped frames.
- Use the existing priority/time index for settled ranking refreshes, retaining full scans when state is uncertain.
- Refuse Library signing transactions when SQLite durability is weakened.
- Keep authority-changing Library transfer and consumer recovery unavailable in ordinary builds.

### Follow-ups

- GLiClass remains a preview with a bounded session cache; durable background classification is not included.
- Social fallback identities and live capture completeness still need follow-up.
- Library transfer and schema-v2 lifecycle activation require a separate owner decision before they can be enabled.

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
